title: Import Recipes From TikTok
description: Save TikTok recipes into TasteBuddy so they become searchable recipes, weekly plans, and shopping lists instead of forgotten video saves.
claims: TikTok is the largest single import source in TasteBuddy's internal dataset.
TasteBuddy supports TikTok recipe capture and conversion into a structured recipe workflow.
supported_workflows: Share a TikTok URL into TasteBuddy
Paste the recipe URL manually
Save the result into your recipe collection
limitations: Some posts require link-in-bio resolution or manual fallback
Low-information posts may need editing after import

faq.question: Can TasteBuddy import a TikTok recipe link directly?
faq.answer: Yes. The app is built to handle recipe import from TikTok links and related fallback flows when the recipe is not directly embedded.

faq.question: What happens after import?
faq.answer: You can keep the recipe searchable, add it to a weekly plan, or generate a shopping list.

proof_points: TikTok accounts for 30% of the tracked import source mix in the internal metrics snapshot.
77% of tracked imports come from URLs rather than manual entry.

title: Import Recipes From Pinterest
description: Take recipe ideas from Pinterest and turn them into cook-ready recipes, meal plans, and shopping lists inside TasteBuddy.
claims: TasteBuddy supports recipe import from Pinterest and food blogs.

supported_workflows: Save the recipe URL from a Pin into TasteBuddy
Keep imported recipes in one searchable collection
Plan the recipe and shop from it later
limitations: Not every Pin points to a recipe page with usable structure

faq.question: Does Pinterest import work best from recipe Pins?
faq.answer: Yes. Pins that lead to recipe pages are the cleanest input because TasteBuddy can extract the recipe from the source page.

proof_points: TasteBuddy's positioning on Pinterest is built around save -> import -> plan -> shop.
TasteBuddy supports recipe import from Pinterest and any food blog.

title: Import Recipes From Obsidian

faq.answer: No. The Obsidian import flow is folder-based and lets you choose the recipe files you want.
